Patient: Priya Szabo | DOB: 05/10/1977 | MRN: SYN-9299173
Date of service: 06/19/2025 | Dr. Isla Ashgrove, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
48-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: gastroesophageal reflux, hypothyroidism.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Methotrexate 25 mg weekly was stopped after 15 weeks because of persistent transaminase elevation (intolerance).

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 33.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
